trigger: An enrolled patient begins or continues an approved monitoring program.
steps: Patient is enrolled under the organization's program rules.
Device assignment and setup are completed.
Device captures or receives a measurement.
Measurement is transmitted through the configured integration.
Platform validates receipt and records processing status.
Configured review or alert rules are applied.
Authorized personnel review information when required.
Approved follow-up or support actions occur.
decisions: Is the reading valid under configured technical rules?
Does the organization's approved workflow require review?
Does the situation require an authorized escalation?
safety_rules: Do not claim that monitoring is continuous unless verified.
Do not promise emergency response unless explicitly supported.
Require clinical approval for patient-facing monitoring instructions.
validation_questions: Which clinical protocols have been approved?
